visual_identity.core_identity: A tall predatory giant with a narrow torso, very long clawed arms, powerful regeneration, and a wary hatred of fire.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall lanky humanoid with a severe hunch, long legs, arms hanging near the ground, and oversized clawed hands.
visual_identity.head_features: Long coarse face, pronounced nose and brow, wide predatory mouth with sharp teeth, deep-set eyes.
visual_identity.body_shape: Deceptively thin but powerful humanoid frame with elongated limbs, hunched upper back, broad hands, and large clawed feet.
visual_identity.surface: Thick rubbery bumpy hide with sparse wart-like irregularities and coarse messy hair on the head; keep texture broad and colorable.

accuracy_checks: body reads lanky rather than ogre-bulky
fire-wary behavior may read when the page story calls for it
arms hang unusually low toward the knees or ground
torso is narrow and lanky, never superhero-built

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

description: A large upright humanoid with a deceptively lean but powerful frame, long ungainly legs, a severe hunch, extremely long hanging arms, massive claws, thick bumpy rubbery hide, and coarse messy hair. Its awkward proportions conceal surprising agility and climbing ability.
